description: Run P: Run N fine-tuned 60 epochs with confusion-aware MixUp/CutMix (half the mixed partners from confusable classes: cat-dog, airplane-ship, airplane-bird, deer-dog, automobile-truck), 4-teacher FM KD + hard aug, all 50k, flip_shift TTA + class-balanced decoding. Twin fs+bal 97.86, suite 96.69, hard 93.08 (below Run N)

Run N + SAM: PreAct-V 4.98M, FM KD from a diverse 4-teacher ensemble + on-the-fly hard augmentation + SAM (rho 0.05) on the student, 600 epochs, all 50k, flip_shift TTA + class-balanced decoding. Twin fs+bal 98.12, suite 97.02, hard 93.73 (ties Run N, McNemar p = 0.64)

PreAct + hard aug: PreAct-V 4.98M, FM KD from a diverse 4-teacher ensemble + on-the-fly hard augmentation (teacher on the clean image, label weight 0.5), 600 epochs, all 50k, flip_shift TTA + class-balanced decoding. Twin fs+bal 98.20, suite 97.03, hard 93.87
Run G, single 4.98M PreAct ResNet, 10-view translation + horizontal-flip probability TTA. Twin validation 97.76%. No class balancing.

Run L: Run I's model (4.62M ResNet, FM KD, 4-teacher ensemble) fine-tuned 100 epochs with on-the-fly hard augmentation (teacher on the clean image, label weight 0.5), all 50k, flip_shift TTA + class-balanced decoding. Twin fs+bal 97.86, hard-suite 93.0

Run M: 4.62M ResNet, FM KD from a diverse 4-teacher ensemble + on-the-fly hard augmentation (low-res, zoom in/out, background; teacher on the clean image, label weight 0.5), 600 epochs, all 50k, flip_shift TTA + class-balanced decoding. Twin fs+bal 97.96, hard-suite 93.6

Run K: Run H's model (4.62M ResNet, FM KD from WRN-28-10, 800 epochs, all 50k) + flip_shift TTA + class-balanced decoding (Sinkhorn T=1, approved by the professor); twin 97.98% clean / 96.79% corruption suite

Run J: Run I's model (4.62M ResNet, FM KD from a diverse 4-teacher ensemble, 800 epochs, all 50k) + flip_shift TTA + class-balanced decoding (Sinkhorn T=1, approved by the professor); twin 97.96% clean / 96.88% corruption suite

Run I: 4.62M ResNet, KD with mixup/CutMix function matching from a diverse 4-teacher ensemble (2x WRN-28-10 SAM, WRN-28-10 AutoAugment, WRN-40-10), 800 epochs, all 50k, flip TTA, twin val 97.92% (none) / 97.82% (flip)
Run H: 4.62M ResNet, KD from WRN-28-10 with mixup/CutMix function matching, 800 epochs, all 50k, flip TTA, twin val 98.00%
Run G: 4.98M PreAct ResNet, KD from WRN-28-10 with mixup/CutMix function matching, 300 epochs, all 50k, flip TTA, twin val 97.58%
Run F: 4.62M ResNet, KD from WRN-28-10 with mixup/CutMix function matching, 300 epochs, all 50k, flip TTA, twin val 97.78%
Run D: distilled from Runs A, B and C, 300 epochs, all 50k images
Run E: 45k twin of Run D (KD from WRN-28-10 + noise, 300 epochs), flip TTA, val 97.50%
Run D: KD from WRN-28-10 + noise robustness, 300 epochs, all 50k images
Run C: robust augmentation, 400 epochs, all 50k images
Run B: same recipe, trained on all 50k images
Run A: 4.98M param wide ResNet, 300 epochs, EMA, flip TTA, val 97.08%
